She polished the great lens until it shone, lit the lamp early, and watched the beam sweep across the water, imagining a stranger somewhere watching it back.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市终于安静下来。路灯在湿漉漉的柏油路上拉出长长的光影，红绿灯仍在无人的路口认真地变换。街角的早餐铺亮起第一盏灯，蒸笼里冒出白色的热气，老板揉着面团，哼着不成调的歌。远处传来环卫车缓慢的轰鸣，扫帚划过地面，沙沙作响。高楼上只剩零星几扇窗还亮着，有人刚刚下班，有人正在醒来。天边仍是深蓝，却隐约透出一线灰白，新的一天正悄悄靠近。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job is solved by doing a smaller copy of the same job, like opening a nesting doll that has a smaller doll inside.\n- Each copy keeps shrinking the job until it is so small that the answer is easy, like the tiniest doll that doesn't open.\n- Then the answers pass back up the line, one copy at a time, until the biggest job is done."}
